warnings: *** SIX SEPARATE ENLARGEMENTS, THREE BATHROOMS x SUPPLY AND DRAINAGE, ALL ON ONE SHEET AT 1:50. *** They are recorded as one plan file with six elements rather than six files, because each carries only a handful of annotations and they share one scale and one subject. Each element_id names both the service and the bathroom, so nothing collides under §0.3.

*** THESE ARE THE ONLY DRAWINGS IN THE SET THAT SHOW ห้องน้ำ 3's DRAINAGE, and they confirm it drains to the same ø4" S / ø2" W arrangement as the upstairs pair even though it sits on the ground floor. SN-01 shows the pipes leaving the building but not their layout inside the room.
THE (ไปลงช่องดัก) AND (ต่อเข้าช่องดัก) NOTES on ห้องน้ำ 1's two views mark where the stack drops into the duct. Recorded in the descriptions; the duct itself is not drawn on any plan in the set.
FCO (floor clean out) IS TAGGED HERE - one of the four symbols SN-01's legend defines. Its sibling RD, RL and ก็อกสนาม are still unused anywhere in the set, as flagged on the legend file.

INDIVIDUAL BRANCH RUNS ARE NOT TRACED. Each enlargement is about 200 px wide on this scan with pipes drawn as single hairlines; recording which branch reaches which fixture would be guesswork. The services, sizes, falls and drains present in each room are recorded instead.
